description:
Paid content for @liveinguizhou604. Join National Geographic photographer and Explorer Chris Burkard on an illuminating journey through Guizhou, China—a province voted by National Geographic twice as one of the world's best destinations. Now, see it like never before as Chris travels through the province's breathtaking mountains, winding rivers, and ancient towns for the adventure of a lifetime. 

Chris' journey into the heart of Guizhou takes him 200 stories up to the top of the world's tallest suspension bridge, Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge, kayaking down the Gaoguo River, exploring the food and nightlife of Zhenyuan Ancient Town, adventuring into Shuanghe Cave, and so much more. Through his lens, Chris captures not only the incredible landscapes of Guizhou, but also the deep, enduring connection between the local community and their land, as the two exist in harmony.
